build_cvat_preannotations: build CVAT preannotations from a parquet dataset by creating project properties, exporting documents, and generating annotation XML files
create_cvat_project_properties: create CVAT project properties file with label categories, colors, and attributes for DocItemLabel, TableComponentLabel, and DocLinkLabel
create_preannotation_files: create CVAT preannotation XML files and page images from an annotation overview, organized into buckets of configurable size
export_from_dataset: export dataset records from parquet files, saving ground truth or predicted documents as JSON and binary files with page images
extract_page_bounding_boxes: extract bounding boxes for all document items on a page, converting document coordinates to image pixel coordinates
